summary: plan.md is written. Five white lattice arches stand in four quartz-rimmed reflecting pools in the courtyard (x 4..59, z 76..159), crown heights y 41 to y 47, the tallest over the crossing walks. Each arch has quartz ribs with end-rod lace inside. Low white wings (roofs at y 20) close the courtyard with a pointed-arch arcade and an elevated promenade. Tall ribbed boxes (y 28) whose ribs fork into pointed arches stand behind, and a 36-wide white IMAX dome sits on the north plaza. All of it reads as the white lace arches over the pools.
